32.old: Condos are strata-titled under the BC Strata Property Act. Request Form B, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the bylaws (rentals, pets and age restrictions) before removing subjects; 55+ and 45+ complexes enforce age bylaws that apply to at least one occupant.
32.new: A condo falls under the BC Strata Property Act as a strata title, which leaves some paperwork to get hold of before you remove subjects. That means the Form B, the depreciation report, the strata minutes for the last two years, and the bylaws that cover rentals, pets and age restrictions. If the complex is 55+ or 45+, at least one occupant must meet its age bylaws.

34.old: Floodplain: parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and lower Sardis lie in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, protected by the City's dike network. Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.
34.new: Parts of Rosedale, Yarrow, Greendale, Fairfield Island and the lower part of Sardis are on the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, and the City's dike network protects those areas. Ask for the flood construction level of the property, and check lender and insurer requirements too. Also find out whether a covenant, geotechnical or floodplain, is registered on title.

36.old: Schools and transit: Chilliwack is served by School District 33 (SD33) — Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and a range of elementary catchments including Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Always confirm catchment with SD33 before buying. BC Transit runs Chilliwack routes along Vedder Road, Luckakuck Way and Young Road, and the Fraser Valley Express (Route 66) links Chilliwack to Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.
36.new: Schools and transit in Chilliwack: the district is School District 33 (SD33), which takes in Sardis Secondary and Chilliwack Secondary as well as G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, with elementary catchments that include Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Before buying, have SD33 confirm the catchment. On buses, BC Transit serves Young Road, and also Luckakuck Way and Vedder Road. Route 66, the Fraser Valley Express, runs out of Chilliwack to Abbotsford and over to Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

47.new: A condo in BC is owned as a strata title and falls under the Strata Property Act. Ahead of removing subjects, get hold of the depreciation report and the Form B, read what the bylaws say about age restrictions, pets and rentals, and pull the strata minutes covering the past two years. Complexes limited to 55+ or 45+ enforce age bylaws, and those apply to at least one occupant.

49.new: If you're looking at Yarrow, Rosedale, Greendale, lower Sardis or Fairfield Island, ask about flood risk, since parts of those areas are on the Fraser and Vedder Rivers floodplain, behind the City's dike network. Worth asking: what lenders and insurers require, the property's flood construction level, and any geotechnical or floodplain covenant on title.

51.new: School District 33 (SD33) is where Chilliwack belongs. Students from Sardis and the south side go to Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham. Chilliwack Secondary is the school for the north side. Boundaries get redrawn, so for a particular address check with SD33.

53.new: Yes. BC Transit's Chilliwack routes include Vedder Road, then Luckakuck Way and Young Road, while the Fraser Valley Express goes on to Abbotsford and Langley. There is little or no bus service in rural parts such as Ryder Lake, Columbia Valley and Greendale.
